title: When the Lantern Falls
author: Dominic Thornbury
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
